notes.title: Small Patch V.5
notes.content:
Hello everyone, this is a small patch for some Quality-of-life fixes as we work towards getting some art done. That is pretty much the only major hurtle we have left!
[h1]Work done:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Beginning to finalize Guns
[*] Fixed Lighting in Camp Smith
[*] Added Gun State (Added not usable to player)
[/list]
[h1]What's to come:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Add dialogue to NPC in the HUB level
[*] Fixing Gun Bugs
[*] Add story NPCs
[*] Work on England map
[*] Flesh out Dialogue
[*] Work on enemies
[*] Work on items
[*] Adding more characters to the game.
[/list]
We understand content is coming along slowly we kindly ask that you be patient as we work towards delivering something unique and fresh!
